fragment: public repr morphology for arrays/tuples and Content::MathOp

arrays.linear_rule: Serialize each item with repr and join item strings with comma+space. Keep linear iff the joined inner body has no newline and its measured ASCII length is <= 50.
arrays.multiline_rule: Otherwise emit opening parenthesis, newline, every item reindented by two spaces per nesting level and followed by comma, newline, then closing parenthesis at the container indentation.
arrays.nesting_obligation: An already multiline item forces its parent multiline; all child lines gain two spaces, child and parent retain trailing commas, and neither representation is flattened.

math_op.rule: Every MathOp emits op(text: <content repr>, limits: <actual bool>) with both named fields in that order. The same pretty multiline discipline applies when field representations require it.
math_op.generality: The rule is structural for MathOp and must not special-case csc, dim, arcsin, native names, or a closed witness list.

non_mathop_control.classification: outside MathOp; preserve its own variant contract

unknown.policy: Unknown never passes as preserved and cannot be generalized from neighboring measured cases.
cases: width-counting unit for non-ASCII item representations
